user_story: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve a task by valid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve the task with ID 1
positive.expected_result: Response status code is 200 and the task details are correctly returned

positive.title: Retrieve a task with full details
steps: Send a request to retrieve the task with ID 2
Verify that the response contains all the required fields: title, description, due date, and status
positive.expected_result: Response contains all task details with correct values

negative.title: Retrieve a task with invalid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve the task with ID -1
negative.expected_result: Response status code is 404 and an error message is returned

negative.title: Retrieve a task with a non-numeric ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve the task with ID 'abc'
negative.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and an error message is returned

edge.title: Retrieve a task with maximum integer ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve the task with the maximum integer value for the ID
edge.expected_result: Response status code is 404 or returns valid task details if the task exists at that ID

edge.title: Retrieve a task with no ID provided
steps: Send a request to retrieve a task without providing an ID
edge.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and an error message is returned stating that ID is required
